source.title: A Brother In Need
source.description: Due to the... unforunate nature of why he left the order, it would be bad comedy for Aeonas to die at the hands of the Scarlet Crusade now. The Crusade is an organization of zealots and lunatics and they've been growing increasingly brazen in their willingness to commit violence against anyone who they imagine to be enemies of the light. Go to the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades and find out if Aeonas still lives.
source.objective: Speak with Katherine to learn more about Aeonas, and then find him in the Scarlet Monastery
source.completion: <Aeonas looks critically injured. He struggles to choke out a few words.> They didn't even... ask me any questions...
